svg.title: Recorded EchoMuse streaming measurements
svg.desc: One HA run delivered first MP3 at 20.275 seconds and reached intent end at 53.753 seconds. A separate concurrent Irina service test delivered first PCM at 2.22 and 4.74 seconds. The test scopes differ and do not measure audible response latency.
